# Linkly

Linkly is a URL shortener and click-tracking platform for branded short links, UTM tagging, retargeting pixels, link rotators, QR codes, and click analytics. To create an API key, sign in to Linkly at linklyhq.com and go to Settings → API Keys.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/linkly/.

## Actions

- **Create or Update Link**: Create a new shortened link or update an existing one in Linkly.
- **Delete Links**: Delete one or more links by their IDs.
- **Get Link By ID** (read-only): Retrieve details for a specific link by ID.
- **List Link Webhooks** (read-only): Retrieve all webhook subscriptions for a specific link.
- **List Links** (read-only): Get a paginated list of all links in a workspace.
- **List Workspaces** (read-only): Retrieve all workspaces the authenticated user has access to.
- **Unsubscribe Webhook From Workspace**: Remove a webhook subscription from a workspace.
- **Delete Link**: Delete a specific link by ID from a workspace.
- **Export Links** (read-only): Export all links in a workspace as JSON or CSV.
- **Get Click Analytics** (read-only): Retrieve click analytics for a workspace.
- **Get Click Counters by Dimension** (read-only): Retrieve click analytics grouped by a specific dimension (counter).
- **Get Link Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific link by its ID.
- **List Domains** (read-only): Retrieve all custom domains configured for a workspace.
- **List workspace webhooks** (read-only): List all webhook subscriptions for a specific workspace.
- **Subscribe webhook to link**: Subscribe a webhook URL to receive notifications when a specific link is clicked.
- **Subscribe Webhook to Workspace**: Subscribe a webhook URL to receive click notifications from a Linkly workspace.
- **Unsubscribe Webhook from Link**: Remove a webhook subscription from a link.
